analysis:
The PR only modifies docs/provider/cli-reference.md, so no executable code or runtime trust logic changes. Unit :5 is base lines 1384-1575 (provider.toml keys, LaunchAgent env passthrough, runtime constants). Unit :6 is head lines 1-423 (the "Last updated: 2026-10-12" banner, macOS<27 upgrade notice, start/schedule/switch/doctor/models docs). The two excerpts cover different regions and are not aligned, so line-by-line comparison was not possible.

Security-relevant doc statements checked:
- The head's macOS<27 notice (lines 54-62) is informational. It says the notice performs no network, config or profile operations, leaves exit codes unchanged, and tells users to keep the MDM profile until App Attest migration is approved. This is consistent with the TB-011/T-052/T-057 notes on legacy and App Attest coexistence and with the T-057 premature-MDM-removal risk.
- The base's prefix-cache/SSD-cache env passthrough (`DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE`, `EIGENINFERENCE_CACHE_ROUTING_MODE` default off) matches T-041. It does not raise the 30-minute TTL or weaken account scoping.
- The hidden native-serve qualification command is documented as requiring an env flag, a signed app, literal 127.0.0.1 transport and owner-only inputs. It is not an installed-service path.

No new attack surface or invalidated threat-model assumption was found. Docs-only, so no threat-model update is needed. Later passes need not re-examine this file unless code changes accompany it. The only coverage limit is that the excerpts do not show the full diff, so changes to unseen regions are unverified.
